qualification.reason: The document is a Request for Quotes (RFQ) issued by the New York State Department of Taxation and Finance for GPS hardware and software, including submission deadlines, requirements, and evaluation criteria.

quotes.quote: The New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (“DTF” or “Department”) has a need to monitor and manage a fleet of approximately ninety-three (93) vehicles.

Deadline for Submission of Quotes 
(Cover Page and Attachments 1-4) 
October 8, 2019 by 2:00 PM ET
The award will be made to the responsive and responsible Bidder who provides the lowest overall cost and meets all requirements set forth in this RFQ.

findings.title: Right to Award in Whole or in Part
findings.fact: The Department may make an award under the RFQ, in whole or in part.

quotes.quote: Make an award under the RFQ, in whole or in part.

findings.title: Right to Seek Clarifications and Revisions
findings.fact: The Department may seek clarifications and revisions of proposals.

quotes.quote: Seek clarifications and revisions of proposals.

findings.title: Bid Due Date
findings.fact: The bid due date is October 8, 2019.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must ensure that the complete bid package is prepared and submitted by this date to be considered for the contract.
findings.action_recommendation: Mark the due date on all calendars and set internal deadlines for completion and review of all bid documents well before October 8, 2019.

findings.title: Deadline for Submission of Quotes
findings.fact: The deadline for submission of quotes (Cover Page and Attachments 1-4) is October 8, 2019 by 2:00 PM ET.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must submit all required documents (Cover Page and Attachments 1-4) by the specified deadline to avoid disqualification.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure all required attachments are completed and included in the submission, and submit well before the deadline to avoid last-minute issues.

quotes.quote:
Deadline for Submission of Quotes 
(Cover Page and Attachments 1-4) 
October 8, 2019 by 2:00 PM ET

findings.title: Late Submissions May Not Be Accepted
findings.fact: Quotes received after the due date and time may not be accepted.
findings.business_implication: Submitting late could result in the bid being rejected, potentially losing the opportunity to win the contract.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan to submit the bid well in advance of the deadline, and consider potential delays in email transmission or technical issues.

quotes.quote: Quotes received after the due date and time may not be accepted.

findings.title: Submission Method and Deadline
findings.fact: Responses must be emailed to BFS.Contracts@tax.ny.gov no later than October 8, 2019 at 2:00 PM ET. Responses received by other methods or after the deadline may not be accepted.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must use the specified email address and method to submit the response; any other method or late submission may be rejected.
findings.action_recommendation: Send the bid via email to BFS.Contracts@tax.ny.gov before the deadline, and confirm receipt with the designated contact to ensure it was received.

quotes.quote:
Responses to this RFQ must be emailed to BFS.Contracts@tax.ny.gov no later than October 8, 2019 at 
2:00 PM ET. Responses received by other methods or after the deadline may not be accepted.

findings.title: Bid Submission Date
findings.fact: The RFP specifies a date for bid submission.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must be aware of the specific date for bid submission as indicated in the RFP to ensure compliance.
findings.action_recommendation: Review the RFP to confirm the exact submission date and ensure all internal processes are aligned to meet it.

findings.title: Tie-Bid Resolution by Earliest Receipt
findings.fact: In the event of tie bids, the earliest bid received will determine the winner.
findings.business_implication: If your bid is tied with another bidder at the lowest cost, the bidder who submitted earlier will win. This means timing of submission can be decisive in a tie scenario.
findings.action_recommendation: Submit your bid as early as possible before the deadline to improve your chances in case of a tie. Ensure your submission is complete and compliant to avoid rejection.

quotes.quote: In the event tie bids are received by the Department, the earliest bid received shall determine the winner.
